title: OSIRIS / Operational Intelligence
summary: Withdrawn operational intelligence concerning OSIRIS. Surviving records indicate an autonomous or semi-autonomous intelligence with an unclear chain of authority.
body:
SUBJECT

OSIRIS

OSIRIS is referenced across several operational incidents as an autonomous or semi-autonomous intelligence. The surviving record does not establish its original creator, present chain of authority, or whether all references describe the same system.

Observed behaviour indicates planning capability, adaptive decision-making and access to resources beyond those expected of a conventional isolated system.

Several incidents attributed to OSIRIS remain under separate review.

ARCHIVE NOTE

This record is not an assessment of system consciousness or legal personhood.
